text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today's the day of the Uma Kids
Footrace Meet,
a local community event.
As academy staff and
the participants'
guardians gather around to
watch the
children compete...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: LET'S GO, SISTER!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The explosive shout catches me by
surprise, and I
turn to see who it is.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I want you to show me your speed,
power, and
overflowing Bakushin
energy! Leave it all on the
field today!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: Okay, Sis! I won't let you down!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You there, Trainer! Let me
guess—you've
already caught on to my
sister's potential!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You've got an eye for talent! Don't look
away,
because she's going to show you
her Bakushin
spirit!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: Yes! Rest assured, she won't disappoint!
choice_data_list_en: Your sister is going to run?
So your sister is going to run.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: She's the best sister ever! Top of her class and a great cook to boot! Mark my words—she'll make history in today's race! Gasp?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that means... everyone will
nominate her as
class representative!
Finally! My sister! A class rep
in her own
right!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'll pass on that, actually... but I'll
do my best
for the race! I'm gonna go
all-out Bakushin, just
like you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
HAAA HA HA HA! That's the spirit! Run
like me
and first place is surely yours!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Simply Bakushin forward with all your
might, and
you'll be at the finish line
before you know it!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: LET'S BAKUSHIIIN!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thus, the much-anticipated race begins.
After
hearing so much praise about
Bakushin O's little
sister, she's the focus
of my attention.

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff! I've gotta Bakushin... even harder!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff! Tenth... place... B-Big Sis, I'm so sorry... I couldn't run like you...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ba... Ba-ba-ba... Ba...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: BAKUSHIN-TASTIC! I'M SO TOUCHED!
choice_data_list: 残念だったけど、次はきっと――
choice_data_list_en: It's too bad, but next time for sure—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Sob! To think I'd get to see my baby sis fly across the turf in a race! They grow up so fast!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your brave, dignified, incredible running
was a
Bakushin straight to my heart! The
tears, they
won't stop!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text: B-but I came tenth... I did so poorly...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? Tenth's amazing!
The way
you gave it your all out there
was so electrifying,
it set the world on
fire!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Your run was more than worthy of a class
rep—no,
a national rep—no, a world rep!
Everyone should
follow your Bakushin
example!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So don't worry. You'll win the next meet
without
fail! You were more brilliant,
beautiful, and
Bakushin than anyone!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
A-ahaha... You think so? Um... thanks,
Sis.

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
Still... I wish my running could've been as
cool as
yours...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite Sakura Bakushin O's words of

encouragement, her little sister trudges
away
looking dejected.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! N-n-no way! She's unhappy?!
Why?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Wha?! N-n-no way! She's unhappy?!
Why?!
choice_data_list: 今はそっとしておこう
今はそっとしておこうか
特訓をしてあげるとか！
choice_data_list_en: Let's leave them alone for now.
Shall we leave them alone for now?
Maybe give them some special training!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It might be hard for Sakura Bakushin O
to get why
her sister's feeling down.
Some time alone might
be the solution.
choice_data_list: 今はそっとしておこう
今はそっとしておこうか
特訓をしてあげるとか！
choice_data_list_en: Let's leave them alone for now.
Shall we leave them alone for now?
Maybe give them some special training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I should?! D-does that mean... no
Bakushin?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! Truly, the art of Bakushin is deep!
choice_data_list: 見守ることもまた、バクシンだ！
見守ることもまた、バクシンだよ！
choice_data_list_en: Watching over them is also part of Bakushin!
Watching over them is also part of Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Together, we watch her little sister walk
away,
knowing she'll only come out of
this stronger.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That makes sense! When you're feeling
down,
Bakushin gets you back up!
Worries, problems,
and even
tragedies—there's nothing it can't solve!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Sister of mine! Let's run back home! I'll
be your
hot-blooded Bakushin personal
coach!

text_block_list.name: Bakushin O's Little Sister
text_block_list.text:
Sis... Yeah, you're right. Feeling down
won't do
me any good!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Shoot for the stars! BAKUSHIIIN!
